case_scope: Fictional supervised campus shuttle dispatch demonstrator. Not a real safety case or field test.
operating_domain: Four designated stops, staffed oversight, limited test periods; all inputs synthetic.

stakeholder_needs.text: Riders must receive understandable booking confirmation and cancellation information.
Dispatch staff must receive timely emergency-status indications.
Operators must be able to reconstruct which vehicle owns a reservation.

requirements.claim: Booking confirmation delivered within 8 seconds under the specified test workload
Status indication end-to-end allocated deterministic timing budget not exceeding 2.5 seconds
No reservation allocated to more than one active vehicle in the specified single-database test
Supervisor can identify stale status messages

hazard_model.assumption: Independent channel failures conditional on no common cause; synthetic probabilities per demand.
